notes.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We're back with another patch live which updates the game to version 1.1.1 (Triple ones!⭐) , where we updated the following:

[list]
[b][*] Fixed a bug that would stop the music early during the “running away from Puchaka” cutscene.
[*] Fixed a small graphical bug during the intro in Chapter 2’s dark encounter.
[*] Fixed a small camera issue during Chapter 3’s dark encounter intro.
[*] Lowered the volume when lights turned on in the Hare’s sanctuary.
[*] Added a fence to the [spoiler]fake Diablo[/spoiler] in the Ancient Mansion.
[*] Blocked a path that allowed you go into the [spoiler]vent[/spoiler] infinitely when [spoiler]confronting Risa[/spoiler].
[*] Adjusted some sounds that were not affected by the audio settings as expected.
[*] Minor grammar fixes in English and Spanish.[/b][/list]
We'll keep you posted on any further bug fixes and are grateful for you flagging these opportunities to make the game even better.

And as always, if you find any bugs, please share them over in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2246470/discussions/0/560246171171396280/]this thread[/url] so we can log them and look into them.

Love from Limbo,
Galla

notes.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We've been so humbled by the feedback you've been leaving for the game, thank you so much!

We wanted to let you know that we've just put a patch live which updates the game to version 1.1.0 , offers volume control options, and a range of fixes documented below.

[list]
[b][*] Added audio settings. You can lower sound, music, and voice volume. Additionally, you can now disable the “Character Voices”.
[*] Adjusted hints for Stadium’s combination lock puzzle.
[*] Adjusted some collisions to prevent the player from going out of bounds.
[*] Some grammar fixes.
[*]  Fixed a bug that allowed the player to use the Warp Pin in unintended locations.
    [*] If you warped out of the Chapter 5 [spoiler]confrontation[/spoiler], you can resume it by interacting with the beacon at the balcony again or entering the Mansion through the front door.
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometime mark the quest to find Astro’s friend as completed until the next day.
[/b]
[/list]

We'll keep you posted on any further bug fixes and are grateful for you flagging these opportunities to make the game even better.

And as always, if you find any bugs, please share them over in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2246470/discussions/0/560246171171396280/]this thread[/url] so we can log them and look into them.

Love from Limbo,
Galla

notes.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - Version 1.0.17
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

We're one week on from launch and thrilled to see how Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo is resonating with our players. If you haven't left a review yet, now would be a great time!

We've just put a patch live which updates the game to version 1.0.17 and offers a range of of fixes documented below.

[list]
[b][*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to interact with the Stadium’s ladder from the outside. Note that if you have managed to reach the [spoiler]dark encounter[/spoiler] of Chapter 3 without the [spoiler]Staff Pass[/spoiler], you’ll be able to rest on the bench in the lobby in Lluvia’s floor to reset the day and get the [spoiler]Staff Pass[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a bug on the Stadium with the [spoiler]supply closet, the light control buttons, and the guard trapped in the bathroom[/spoiler] not resetting properly at the end of the day.
[*] Fixed a softlock when interacting with the vines in the Mansion for some users.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Parachute Blanc Soul’s bottle to disappear if not collected after helping them.
[*] Restored [spoiler]luggage[/spoiler] containing bottle #2 after Train is repaired.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Kulebra’s mask to appear invisible when loading a file for the first time.
[*] Fixed a bug that froze Kulebra when loading a completed file first and then loading a non-completed file or starting a new game.
[*] Improved dead zone for joystick inputs to reduce drift.
[*] Fixed missing localization from broken Vending Machine and Bat Blanc Soul.
[*] Fixed audio mixing issues in the Toro sequence.
[*] Corrected various grammatical errors.
[/b]
[/list]
We'll keep you posted on any further bug fixes and are grateful for you flagging these opportunities to make the game even better.

If you find any bugs, please share them over in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2246470/discussions/0/560246171171396280/]this thread[/url] so we can log them and look into them.

Love from Limbo,
Galla

Love from Limbo,

notes.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo is available now!
notes.content:
Hello Denizens of Limbo!

Our cozy papercraft adventure Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo is available now, with a limited-time* launch discount of 10% off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/f053b5b4d19b833f693ab84eebf218a986ac4bdd.gif[/img]

We invite you to join us in the world of Limbo, a vibrant Latin American-themed afterlife where souls are trapped in an endless cycle of repeating the same day on end. Play as Kulebra, a (very) dead snake with no knowledge of his past 💀

[previewyoutube=5dG296X8oP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Kulebra awakens in Limbo and meets a mysterious, yet friendly old woman who tasks him with solving the mysterious curse that has trapped the souls who live there. In doing so, she promises that he will find answers to his own mystery 🕵️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/b0a6e1f2e27ca1780af5f1937ece447965280148.png[/img]

Whether you’re here for the quirky characters, emotional stories, or just the chance to explore a bright and hopeful version of the afterlife, we can’t wait for you to experience what Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo has to offer 💖

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]🎒 Explore and interact with the world to gather clues and items that will help you open doors in your quest (figuratively and literally)
[*]🔎 A game that will reward you for interacting with the world, paying attention to details, and connecting the dots
[*]🗣️ Full of characters with their own quirks, side stories, and schedules that bring life to this world despite most of them being very dead
[*]⏳ An in-game day, dusk, and night cycle that will change the world and characters, ending with the curse that resets the souls of Limbo back to the start
[*]📒 A notebook will keep track of important details for you, so you can't blame me if you weren't paying attention
[*]💥 Confront the dark souls attempting to put out your light; Overcome their challenges that will test everything you’ve learned in this journey
[*]💬 Bilingual! This game supports the English and Latin American Spanish languages
[/list]

With its warm tone, character-driven storytelling, emphasis on exploration and and clever, yet accessible puzzles, Kulebra invites you to slow down, connect with the locals, and explore a space where kindness and curiosity go hand in hand 🤝

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/1fc15e763bdbe777c5aa47c307c63a6fd4b14f31.gif[/img]

You can follow Kulebra’s journey by joining the official [url=https://bit.ly/3sK8Bhh]Galla Games Discord[/url] 🎮 or follow the devs on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/gallagames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/galla_games]Twitter/X[/url], or [url=https://www.instagram.com/gallagames]Instagram[/url] 🗣️

If you’ve gotten this far, then you’re probably interested in supporting narrative indie games. If that’s the case, then don’t forget to leave us a review if you’re picking it up here on Steam. Not only do we want to hear from you about what you like (or don't!), but reviews are the BEST way to support indie devs and really help other players discover small games like ours.

[i]*Discount ends May 27[/i]

notes.title: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

As we get closer to launch, we took a look at the demo and decided that it could use an update so players can get a better sense of what to expect from the final game.

Additionally, players of the new version of the demo will now be able to continue their progress and pick up right where they left off in the final game!*

And so, we've just pushed an update for the demo live! It includes the following fixes, additions and quality of life changes.

[list]
[*] Quality of life changes and improvements, such as a new inventory UI, faster menus, smoother movement, more benches and improved performance.
[*] Players will be able to transfer their save file to the final game.*
[*] We've added input remapping for keyboard and controllers.
[*] The intro and outro has been updated.
[*] There’s now one message in a bottle that the player can find.
[*] It’s a smaller build! 
[/list]

We've also made some updates to the ruins / temple area in the demo, so you please explore the area and let us know what you think!

We hope you enjoy these update to the Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo demo, and please look forward to more news on the launch of the game very soon!

[i][b]*Note:[/b] Previous demo saves will not be compatible with the new version of the demo, or the final version of the game. We apologize for any inconvenience.[/i]

Don't forget to wishlist the game, and also join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/W48P2dvdTj]Galla Discord[/url] for updates about the game, and to chat with the community.

notes.title: Galla Developer Blog #2
notes.content:
[h1Let's talk about the new things coming up![/h1]

Welcome to our second Dev Blog! This time we'd like to share with you some of the new features you can expect from the full version of Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo.
If you need a refresher of what's already in the demo, you can check our first blog post. But for now, let's not waste any more time and get to it!



[h1]A Bigger World[/h1]
The chapters that come after the demo end will expand the world of Limbo considerably. Chapter 2 alone is about three times as big as Chapter 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/eb7fd332cbab07a6e1f53c14616bf0ff5a2f3505.gif[/img]

The extra space gives us more freedom in where and how we set up the puzzles, the lore, and the characters (and more places to hide pearls too). This opening up of the world is what opens the door to all the features we'll be telling you about here.
We hope you enjoy exploring the world beyond the frontiers of Dead Valley! We made a big effort to make sure each Chapter of Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo has its own flavor.


[h1]Blanc Souls[/h1]

In your journey through Limbo you'll spot many puffy-looking cloud-like folks. These are Blanc Souls, spirits with a shaky, delicate link to something unresolved that keeps them trapped in Limbo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/dcccf6b559a64057b9d88388b2de2e5d0893fed3.png[/img]

Because the thing that keeps them in Limbo is relatively trivial, only a part of them manifests, which results in these cuddly clouds. If you have the time, why not set aside a few minutes and see if you can help them? While it’s not necessary to move the story forward, they're usually pretty generous.
In case you're having trouble looking for these fellas, you can always visit the Wing Union's help board to see what souls need some helping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/6c93896bcf82d4e29c1c1876b19d8532d27f3c8e.png[/img]

[h1]Sneaking[/h1]

We have briefly teased this one in our store page. It's time we go more in depth about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/95c15f7ced4c371d1029dcb94955000482db09dd.gif[/img]

At various points you'll need to sneak around guards. The "why" might change, but the goal is all the same: Stay out of their line of sight and look out for an opening to get by. If you do get spotted then it's time to shift gears and get the heck outta there! Don't let that happen; Pay attention to the guards and all of  the tools at your disposal to succeed.

The sneaking sections themselves are a puzzle; It’s not only about getting by undetected, you’ll need to take care of obstacles to reach your goal (A mix of tension and puzzle solving). They bring an occasional change of pace that the game’s flow benefits a lot from; Same reason why we came up with the “Dark Soul” encounters.

This was originally a one-time thing, but it fit so well that we decided to expand on it (And the game stars a snake, so it's only natural!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/cce77dbd9880e232acb9eb8f52ad5f58a9feab59.png[/img]


[h1]Meteor Pearls[/h1]

While wandering at night, you will occasionally spot a pink meteor fall from the sky. These are known as "Meteor Pearls", and it's another way to gather pearls in your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/09600aea57c5ebe2602b43cfd5bd934268e71bc3.gif[/img]

While you won't spot them during the daytime or evening, falling pearls you miss can always be picked up during the next cycle. There might be new pearls in areas you've cleared out before, so it helps to always keep an eye out for their sparkles.

If you're in need of some pearls, the "Meteor Pearls Report" around Limbo will help hint you at any nearby pearls. There are some new things after the demo concludes you'll be able to use them for. You won’t need to find every single one of them to progress, but don’t let that stop you if you want to track them all down. Some of the residents of Limbo might trade you something for them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/8ab2bdfba541108255e016ac3312b9d0965f54f5.png[/img]


[h1]Drinks[/h1]

It's time we talk about something we’ve teased in some of our previews on social media, the various new drinks available for purchase!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/96c8c567de22307c9144a4d0d2034800d3b788f2.png[/img]

These drinks will provide effects that will make your time in Limbo easier. This includes things like moving faster, giving you more time in a day, etc. Not only are they convenient, but they might help you get out of a tight spot. It's good to always keep a few on hand just in case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/f7083defe3fb993eced78ba2e1d8f37ba870b1ce.gif[/img]


[h1]Messages in a Bottle[/h1]

One of the many trinkets you can find in Limbo are Messages in Bottles. You can think of these as fortune cookies scattered around Limbo waiting for you to discover them. Some have words of advice, some have a pretty picture, some have both!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/ccb8529e341f4aabf4c63eac29b64493d33f2c88.png[/img]

A good chunk of these messages have been brought to you by our wonderful Kickstarter backers. We hope you enjoy reading them!


[h1]And Plenty to Discover[/h1]

There are many more things to look forward to, but of course we don't want to spoil the surprises! For now, we hope these previews give you a better idea of what to expect, and we hope you're just as excited as we are to the full release.

Thank you for ready, and peace!

notes.title: Galla Developer Blog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! [/h1]

Welcome to the beginning of our series of blog posts for Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo!

Leading up to the release of the game, we'll be sharing with you some "kool" details about the game every month! We're talking things like upcoming game mechanics, early character and world designs, behind-the-scenes work, and a lot more!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/3d1efe6b15e3fd71cad6ba780353a2c3841f7486.gif[/img]

For today, we want to introduce you to the world of Limbo and some interesting things  to look forward to!

[h1]The World of Limbo[/h1]

Limbo is a place where troubled souls linger in search of fulfilling something that they couldn't in their lifetime. Unable to let go of their worries, they are cursed to repeat the same day over and over, unless they're helped and guided towards reaching a resolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/3c53aad6fdbf6f5adf0452c3bbe1d16965a9f68b.png[/img]

You'll follow the journey of one of these many souls, Kulebra. A snake with a heart of gold, Kulebra is somehow able to remember events from previous cycles. A mysterious Old Lady indicates that Kulebra is a "Bright Soul", a compassionate spirit that can also illuminate the way for those lost in Limbo. Perhaps guiding others along their path can help shine that light on your own and answer the mystery of “Why are YOU here?” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/7b2148cadf459b9a13661fef2cca7eb16eee4b07.gif[/img]

While Limbo is the land of the dead, that has not stopped some lively and featherly friends from making their way into it. The Wing Union is an organization who have taken it upon themselves with aiding the lost souls in finding their way. Krow is one of its many members that will be accompanying you in your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/1e5c102ae4a89c6a9282a8173d0fe8ca86c29815.png[/img]

[h1]A Detective from, and for, the Great Beyond[/h1]

Knowledge and items are your main tools to the challenges that await you in Limbo. Through exploration (and snooping around) you'll learn about its inhabitants and will find many objects at your disposal. It's up to you to connect these puzzle pieces to discover more about the inhabitants and continue on your journey in this land of the dead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/420569abba764f087988636953a76932e56dc3ce.png[/img]

There are three main things you can do with items: Use, Combine, and Examine. Using an item depends on the context; Use a key to open a door, give a letter for someone to read. Combine will allow you to, well, combine two compatible items into one. And lastly, examine will let you spot details that might be hidden at first glance.

The how and when to use them will be revealed by the clues you find! You can think of them as keys with locks that you'll have to discover through clever thinking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/3065a66a8d6bdbd394542f2307f9fdfe20db9b9c.png[/img]

As for these clues I keep mentioning, don’t worry, you don’t need a perfect memory! This is where your trusty Notebook comes into play. It'll keep track of important notes about the folks you meet. It will also track objectives and side-quests so that you can get right back on track if you take a break! It's definitely one of the features that ended up being a lot more useful than we initially thought!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/b9bf43be5dc53ac26b402d12c009ef41d1c2e6d0.png[/img]

[h1]Breaking the Cycle[/h1]

One of the “koolest” features in this game is its time and schedule system! As you play, time will progress, bringing changes to the environment and characters within it. A day is divided into three sections: Daytime, evening, and nighttime; Each one brings a different mood to the world, and a change to the world's characters depending on their routine. Learning of the events throughout a day is a crucial part of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/f23333dc13a4f1bc68410b6464cbcf62edf53cd6.png[/img]

The curse of Limbo keeps souls trapped in a never-ending time loop. At the end of the day, you'll be sent back to the start, with the souls you've met forgetting everything they (or you) did. But don't fret, not only is this something you can turn to your favor, but there's also a way for your actions to not end in vain. If you manage to have a strong impact on a soul, these memories will linger even after a reset in the form of a "Soul Mark". As a “Bright Soul” you have the ability to leave lasting changes on this cursed land and the denizens within it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/ef533d05bbe1ca448aa2d3703ca0095392c99bee.png[/img]

[h1]The Darkness in those who Refuse[/h1]

Every soul in Limbo has a different reason for ending up there, and some are not willing to leave and let go that easily. Those that refuse to confront their problems will be slowly poisoned by them, eventually turning them into a "Dark Soul".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/9b8a656f5327d01c1fd7c707c2f99c786c0d91f9.png[/img]

When pushed to confront their deep-rooted fears, these "Dark Souls" lash out in an effort to deny them. If not brought back to their senses, they will eventually be consumed by their darkness, dragging those nearby with them somewhere where there is no return.

In these cases, you'll need to guide the "Dark Souls" back to their former selves by answering questions about things you've learned about them. You can think of these as a "final exam" of sorts. Think carefully about what you say to them, and use your notebook if you're not sure. Otherwise, you might end up making things worse! These are tense conflicts that bring a sense of danger to the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/769e45046354d4e9221e953995176d279bf7e32c.png[/img]

[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]

This game has been our biggest endeavor thus far. It's been 6 years of work and love we've put into this project, and there's still lots to go! We've only gotten this far thanks to the support and encouragement of the many wonderful people we've met during all these years. From our early players, fellow developers, our Kickstarter backers, friends and family, and the folks at Fellow Traveller; This project is only here thanks to all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/6dae06ee4c9f504b985bc2a39e7b831b20f51828.png[/img]

There's still so much to talk about, and this is just the beginning of it. Next post we'll go over some new features that will be present in the full version of Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo! 

If you haven't played the demo yet, please give it a whirl and tell us what you think. We're excited to bring you along with us and thank you for joining us on this journey of ours!

Thanks for reading, and enjoy your day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/125ea7141e9e8e35dfb4460b9e5f37f8b378385b.png[/img]

notes.title: The annual Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale starts today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44619688/ecc83084e24dfc49bd19b2dd4f8cf08747796ae0.png[/img]

[h3]The Annual Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale starts today, with up to 90% off narrative games[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023][b]➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️[/b][/url]

There are plenty of indie narrative titles on sale from Fellow Traveller - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

Sale ends 1st October.

[h3]Along with Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo, there are two new games joining the Fellow Traveller family; [b]Scrabdackle[/b] and [b]Wander Stars[/b]  - read up on each of them below![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575810/Wander_Stars/]Wander Stars[/url]:[/b] Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/]Scrabdackle[/url]:[/b] As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.[/list]So get exploring and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]grab some great narrative games[/url]!
